cell_type_rule: most specific is_a ancestor-or-self in cell_type_targets.tsv (part_of and develops_from not followed); ties by target-file order; pins.tsv overrides; no target -> self; a term absent from or obsolete in the pinned CL release -> self (method not_in_ontology)
summary_excluded_rule: native term that rolls up to a target in broad_targets.tsv and is an is_a ancestor-or-self of another target; no_target terms are never excluded; left out of the cross-dataset summary only
tissue_rule: CELLxGENE Census TissueMapper: first tissue_general list entry that is an ancestor-or-self (guide closure, is_a + part_of); else self; CL and CVCL tissues -> self
development_stage_rule: prenatal when a prenatal_roots term is an ancestor-or-self (guide closure, is_a + part_of); unknown and terms not in the guide are not; a dataset whose every listed stage is prenatal is left out of the cross-dataset summary only
